prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity interaction-detail board showing TWO STATES OF THE SAME Workbench component, side by side, as crisp flat UI screenshots. This is a close-up of the approved research-program panel and its attached composer, not alternative layouts. The supplied screenshot is the exact visual and composition reference: preserve its dark restrained materials, Geist type, compact topic navigation, single focused question and shared composer. Omit unrelated app header, conversation and floating context from the close-up. Landscape board, generous readable text. Each panel shows the entire research-program/composer unit at the same scale. Thin line icons, no marketing, device frame, invented AI work or new product controls. UI in English; a small outside label marks each state. "Illustrative" outside the UI.
Interaction: Add research question. Left label "Draft". Program still contains four questions, Switching selected, focused question "What makes switching difficult?" with rationale "Separate contractual participation from integrations and operating dependencies." The existing composer is in mode "Add research question", with Cancel. Its draft is "What happens to CCC's pricing power if agents handle claim intake?" and its action is Add question. Start research remains visible but disabled while this draft is unresolved.
Right label "After Add question". Same panel, now five questions. The compact navigation adds a fifth topic "Pricing", selected. Focused question is now "What happens to CCC's pricing power if agents handle claim intake?" Show "5 of 5". Do not invent an AI-generated rationale for the added text. Small confirmation "Question added". Composer has returned to its ordinary compact placeholder "Refine the framing…", with icon-only send. Start research is enabled again. The original four questions stay present in the navigator. No extra input form inside the question.
purpose: Detail of one previously discussed interaction, draft and applied states; not an alternative composition
